archimate:ValueStream.name: VS-07.5 Audit, Certify, and Report Compliance
archimate:ValueStream.documentation:
Once quality and compliance are monitored, results are formally reviewed and documented. Internal or external auditors verify adherence to policies, standards, and regulations. Findings are summarized in audit reports and quality certifications that demonstrate accountability and transparency.
These results are shared with governance boards, management, and — when relevant — external stakeholders such as Eurostat or national authorities.
This step ensures that the organization’s commitment to compliance is visible, verifiable, and continuously improved.
Value created: Documented and certified proof of compliance and statistical quality.
